preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 50.
Number of students (computers) is between 1 and 1000.
Number of connections is between N-1 and 100000.
Number of queries is between 1 and 100000.
Computer indices u and v are between 1 and N.
Distance d between computers is between 1 and 1000000.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(stdout.splitlines()) == t + sum(M for _ in range(t)))
postconditions.description: Output has the correct number of lines for each test case and each query.

postconditions.expression: all('Case: ' + str(i+1) in stdout.splitlines()[i*sum(M for _ in range(t)) + i] for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: Each test case starts with 'Case: case_no'.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.splitlines()[i*sum(M for _ in range(t)) + j + i + 1]) == min_length(u, v) for i in range(t) for j, (u, v) in enumerate(queries[i]))
postconditions.description: For each query, the output is the minimum length of cable used to connect computers u and v.
